one.definition: The smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number.

two.definition: One of the four playing cards in a deck that have two spots.

three.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck having three pips.

four.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of three and one.

five.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of four and one.

six.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of five and one.

seven.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with seven pips on the face.

eight.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with eight pips on the face.

nine.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with nine pips on the face.

ten.definition: One of four playing cards in a deck with ten pips on the face.

eleven.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one.

twelve.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one.

thirteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of twelve and one.

fourteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of thirteen and one.

fifteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of fourteen and one.

sixteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of fifteen and one.

seventeen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of sixteen and one.

eighteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of seventeen and one.

nineteen.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of eighteen and one.

twenty.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nineteen and one.

thirty.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and three.

forty.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and four.

fifty.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and five.

sixty.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and six.

seventy.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven.

eighty.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and eight.

ninety.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and nine.

thousand.definition: The cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100.

million.definition: The number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros.

first.definition: Preceding all others in time or space or degree.

second.definition: A part or voice or instrument or orchestra section lower in pitch than or subordinate to the first.

third.definition: One of three equal parts of a divisible whole.

fifth.definition: Position five in a countable series of things.

sixth.definition: One part in six equal parts.

seventh.definition: One part in seven equal parts.

eighth.definition: One part in eight equal parts.

ninth.definition: Position nine in a countable series of things.

subtraction.definition: An arithmetic operation in which the difference between two numbers is calculated.

multiplication.definition: An arithmetic operation that is the inverse of division.

division.definition: One of the portions into which something is regarded as divided and which together constitute a whole.

equals.definition: To be identical or equivalent to.

plus.definition: A sign indicating the operation of addition.

minus.definition: An arithmetic operation in which the difference between two numbers is calculated.

times.definition: An arithmetic operation that is the inverse of division.

percentage.definition: A proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred).
